$comment: Non-secret production identifiers only. A parameter whose value is an object with a `pending` issue reference is not yet decided; the renderer refuses to produce production output while any parameter used by the template is pending. Never put connection strings, keys or passwords here.

SqlBootstrapIp.reason: The API needs one static egress address before the runner can open the temporary SQL bootstrap firewall rule.

ReleaseFeedServiceIndex.reason: Must be the verified producer feed that carries the exact SQL package versions declared by the admitted dogfood release.

ReleaseVerificationClientId.reason: Choose the attached identity that holds registry read at valenceruntimeimages; grant AcrPull there first.

ReleaseVerificationBlobRedirectHost.reason: Exact blob host observed during the live verification proof.

ReleaseProducerSignatureSubject.reason: Exact producer workflow identity of the admitted release.

ReleaseProducerOidcIssuer.reason: Issuer of the producer workflow identity.
